title: config/knip-entries.json
description: What the repository adds to knip.json, the copy of kit: the entry files that make runs outside its layout entries, the system tools of the repository that its scripts spawn, the root dependencies that only make runs, the files that are not code of the repository, and its nested npm projects as knip workspaces, each with its reason. make lint-ts runs knip with knip.json and these additions, and leaves the files of ignore out of oxlint too (scripts/kit/lint-ts.mts).

entries.description: Each entry glob, relative to the root, with the reason that it is an entry, such as the make target that runs it.

binaries.description: Each system tool that the scripts, tests or package.json scripts of the repository run and no npm package provides, such as make, go, php or Apple container, with the reason; knip.json names none, since no copy of kit runs one, and knip itself ignores its global binaries, such as node, git, python3 and cargo (K176).

ignoreDependencies.description: Each dependency of the root package.json that no JavaScript imports and only make runs, such as a compiler that a recipe of the Makefile runs (knip does not read the Makefile), with the reason; knip ignores it after the ignoreDependencies of knip.json.

ignore.description: Each glob, relative to the root, of files that are not code of this repository, such as a sample source file that a site shows and nothing runs or imports, or an input of the tests of a build tool that is broken on purpose, with the reason: neither knip nor oxlint reads them. knip ignores them after the ignore of knip.json, and oxlint by an --ignore-pattern for each glob.

workspaces.description: Each nested npm project, its directory relative to the root (never the root, which knip.json configures), that knip reads as a workspace of its own with its package.json, instead of reporting its dependencies as unlisted at the root.

reason.description: Why the project exists, such as the tests that load it.

entries.description: Each entry glob of the project, relative to its directory, with its reason; without it knip takes the entries of its plugins and of package.json.

ignoreDependencies.description: Each dependency of the project that no JavaScript of it imports, such as one that only Rust tests load, with its reason.
